strategy: Port shared infrastructure; preserve application-specific behavior.
adaptations: Interline theme, lazy color generation, locale-owned direction, and per-component shadow CSS are retained.
The existing host-scheme detector implements ColorSchemeSource; template demo UI and its optional detector are not copied.
Satellite styles remain lazy and are released when the last satellite is destroyed.
Application permissions, services, entrypoints, tests, and bundle boundaries are retained.
noUncheckedIndexedAccess keeps the previous application policy; other WXT strict defaults remain enabled.
